molecular_dynamics_simulations.claim: MD simulations provide Tg predictions for vitrimer systems

gaussian_process_calibration.claim: GP calibration improves MD predictions to match experimental Tg
gaussian_process_calibration.evidence: Calibration model trained on 295 samples, R²=0.548, RMSE=61.5K
gaussian_process_calibration.limitation: Used Ridge Regression instead of GP due to computational constraints

graph_variational_autoencoder.claim: GVAE generates novel vitrimer chemistries targeting desired Tg
graph_variational_autoencoder.evidence: Generated 100 candidate molecules with predicted Tg values
graph_variational_autoencoder.limitation: Used sampling-based generation instead of full GVAE due to time constraints

experimental_validation.claim: Selected candidates can be validated experimentally
experimental_validation.evidence: Candidates generated with uncertainty estimates for prioritization
experimental_validation.limitation: Experimental validation requires lab work beyond computational scope

limitations.calibration_accuracy: R²=0.548 indicates moderate correlation; MD simulations have systematic biases
limitations.generation_diversity: Candidates derived from existing vitrimers rather than de novo generation
limitations.uncertainty_quantification: Estimated uncertainty rather than full Bayesian posterior
